releases.title: Clearer first visit, guide and Companion
notes: First visit has one list of sections: the duplicate Also show checkboxes are gone, Digest sections names what is on, and the settings below Brew are labelled Optional settings.
The guide, start page and Data & compute were rewritten to be shorter and plainer, and the guide now explains Interested.

The Companion now explains what it is for: a helper on your own computer for Claude Code or Codex summaries, email and scheduled brews. It is not remote access. Its setup steps now say where the token is and which options scheduled brews and email need.
Once connected, the Companion lists what is ready and how to turn on the rest; Claude Code and Codex show (needs Companion) on the website instead of being silently greyed out.
Smaller fixes: '1 helpful rating' grammar, the Saved page names the real Save button, and settings labels such as Add topic and About you are clearer.

releases.title: Fellowships, awards and tracked deadlines, matched to your country
notes: Events & Calls now lists fellowships and awards for your country, plus schemes open to anyone such as MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships, HFSP and EMBO.
Mark a grant, call or event Interested to track it: its deadline and how long is left appear under Coming deadlines on every digest and on the Saved page.
New funding from UKRI (UK) and the Swiss National Science Foundation. Funders that serve only other countries are no longer fetched for you, and with only Funding on, fellowships stay there.

New meetings from Keystone, Cold Spring Harbor, Nature Conferences, Wellcome Connecting Science, ISSCR, CRS, FEBS, FASEB and ECI, the Biophysical Society in local installs, plus hand-checked Gordon, MRS, ACS and RSC meetings.
Lighter cards: ratings sit in one quiet row, Mark known and Copy summary moved under More, and j, k, 1–4 and s work as keyboard shortcuts.
Cards put the topic tag above the title, the journal on its own line and authors | date below it; Wiley table-of-contents images now open; Details labels author statements as stated.

Updating keeps more of your own: it copies your data first, removes program files a release dropped, and leaves your own sources in data/sources.local.yaml alone. Theme, density and Pip now travel with backups.

On the website, storage protection is requested after your first brew, browsers that may clear data after a week remind you to back up sooner, and an empty desk offers Restore a backup first. eLife and Import AI feeds moved to their working addresses.

releases.title: More funding and events, clearer reading, one-click updates
notes: Funding brews work again in the browser after a change on Grants.gov.
Funding now matches your country: NIH Guide for the US, EU Funding & Tenders (Horizon Europe, ERC, MSCA) for Europe.
Events now include EMBO workshops and courses worldwide, and every upcoming EMBL event.
Journal names are written out in full and lead each card; compact view is fixed.
Updates now say what changed and install with one click.
